title: −60 to 50 °C ultrawide-temperature flexible zinc–air batteries enabled by a ternary polar hydrogel electrolyte
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,9502-9511
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03421C, Paper
Jun Wang, Xifan Chen, Song Jin, Ying Zhang, Zhengkun Yang, Junzhong Wang, Juan-Ding Xiao, Xiaoping Gao, Jia Yang
A ternary polar hydrogel electrolyte with high ionic conductivity and anti-freezing and anti-dehydration properties is developed for −60 to 50 °C adaptive Zn–air batteries.
